source: victor-en-c-2 (casting n° 2 du 18/10/2026, voix 3 validée par Kévin avec la musique Télégraphe)
design: A charismatic British male morning radio host, about 55, with a warm, slightly husky, textured baritone voice, the kind of intimate radio voice listeners trust at dawn, with a smile in it. Calm authority and an unhurried rhythm. Native British English broadcast diction from London, no foreign accent. Close-microphone broadcast studio sound, natural breathing, expressive and human, never robotic, never shouting.

energique.texte: Eight a.m. in Paris. Good morning, trading floor! This is Victor Castel, and you're listening to Macro Arsenal Radio. Strong coffee, screens on: three minutes around the world.

net.texte: Crossing the screens: Asia opened cautiously, oil is firming, and the dollar is waiting for its big moment at two thirty, Paris time.

complice.texte: From the floor. January the fifteenth, twenty fifteen. I was on the microphone when the Swiss National Bank scrapped its floor. Within minutes, the franc jumped almost thirty percent against the euro.

pose.texte: That morning, I understood one thing: it's not the news that blows up an account. It's having no plan.

chaleureux.texte: The market will still be here tomorrow. So will your capital, if you protect it. This was Victor Castel. See you tomorrow at eight!
